name: Claude Meter
description:
Claude subscription usage (5-hour and weekly limits) and Claude Code token counts in the top bar, with an animated Clawd for each open Claude Code session and a page to clean up old conversations.

Requires a paid Claude Pro or Max subscription signed in through Claude Code: without it the extension only shows an error.

Privacy: it reads the Claude Code files in ~/.claude (credentials, conversation logs, session list) and sends the OAuth token only to api.anthropic.com, to read the plan usage. Nothing else leaves the computer. Not affiliated with Anthropic.
